content: ⌊ DRAFT g In case the SwCluCDcmProxyDiagnosticData channel related to a DataServices_{Data} PortPrototype s is connected, the Dcm Proxy shall • read the dataElement / nvData , when the corresponding Xxx_ReadData API is called in the Dcm Low Proxy , OR • write the dataElement / nvData , when the corresponding Xxx_WriteData API is called in the Dcm Low Proxy . In that case IN argument Data (if applicable) is sent to the receiver, and OUT argument Data (if applicable) is transferred back to the caller of the Dcm Low Proxy .
